Small treasure quest in {wiki:Inukaya|Inukaya}, the Chakoya camp near Svargrond. Travel by dog sled from Nibelor, enter an igloo in the village and search a barrel to find a fur bag with a {item:Shard}, 48 gold and 3 {item:Rainbow Trout|Rainbow Trouts}.
{wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest} done at least up to the mission **Nibelor 5: Cure the Dogs** (the first five missions), so that you can use the sled.
one for each sled trip (there and back)
Bring **one {item:Ham} for each trip**: without it the dogs will not take you, neither there nor back.
Round trip: Svargrond → {npc:Iskan} ({key:passage}) → Nibelor → dog sled → Inukaya; return by sled to Nibelor and then {npc:Nilsor} ({key:passage}) to Svargrond.

In **Svargrond**, go to the ice area **north/northeast** of the city and talk to {npc:Iskan}, the owner of the dog sled: {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you to the island of {wiki:Nibelor|Nibelor} (he only accepts after you have done the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest|Barbarian Test Quest} and the first mission of the Ice Islands Quest).

In **Nibelor**, enter the {wiki:Dog sled|dog sled} that is just **east** of where you arrive from Svargrond. The dogs eat a {item:Ham} and take you to **Inukaya**, in the Chakoya camp on the island of **Grimlund**, east of Nibelor.
You need to have a {item:Ham} with you and to have done the first five missions of the Ice Islands Quest; otherwise the dogs will not take you.
Map of Grimlund, where Inukaya is
Walk to the Chakoya village and enter the igloo marked on the map.
In the village there are {creature:Chakoya Toolshaper|Chakoya Toolshapers}, {creature:Chakoya Tribewarden|Chakoya Tribewardens} and {creature:Chakoya Windcaller|Chakoya Windcallers}.
Search the barrel marked in the image: it has a leather bag with the rewards.
The barrel with the leather bag inside the igloo
To leave Inukaya, use the same {wiki:Dog sled|dog sled} you arrived on: go back to it and enter it again (the dogs eat another {item:Ham}) to return to **Nibelor**.
If you run out of {item:Ham} in Inukaya, the dogs will not take you back. Always bring an extra one.
In Nibelor, go west of the stone circle and talk to {npc:Nilsor}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you back to **Svargrond**.
